package domain

import (
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"strings"
)

const OnboardingPathAuthoringInputSchema = "planner-onboarding-path-authoring-input.v1"

// OnboardingPathAuthoringInput is intentionally smaller than the legacy
// planning profile. Optional Student values stay absent; S9 never invents
// stacks, pace, minutes, mastery, or free-text planning intent.
type OnboardingPathAuthoringInput struct {
	Schema                 string       `json:"schema"`
	Goal                   LearningGoal `json:"goal"`
	TopologyHash           string       `json:"topology_hash"`
	PlannerVersion         string       `json:"planner_version"`
	PedagogyProfile        string       `json:"pedagogy_profile"`
	PresentationStyle      string       `json:"presentation_style"`
	GenerationPolicy       string       `json:"generation_policy"`
	ContentLanguage        string       `json:"content_language"`
	DirectionCode          string       `json:"direction_code,omitempty"`
	SelfAssessedExperience string       `json:"self_assessed_experience,omitempty"`
	KnownStacks            []string     `json:"known_stacks,omitempty"`
	DesiredStacks          []string     `json:"desired_stacks,omitempty"`
}

func NewOnboardingPathAuthoringInput(graph GoalGraph, policy PolicyBundle, snapshot StudentPlanningReadinessSnapshot) (OnboardingPathAuthoringInput, error) {
	graph, err := NormalizeGoalGraph(graph)
	if err != nil {
		return OnboardingPathAuthoringInput{}, err
	}
	policy, err = NormalizePolicyBundle(policy)
	if err != nil {
		return OnboardingPathAuthoringInput{}, err
	}
	snapshot, err = NormalizeStudentPlanningReadinessSnapshot(snapshot)
	if err != nil || snapshot.Profile.ContentLanguage == nil {
		return OnboardingPathAuthoringInput{}, ErrValidation
	}
	topology, err := json.Marshal(struct {
		Goal        LearningGoal          `json:"goal"`
		Targets     []LearningTarget      `json:"targets"`
		Transitions []TransitionKnowledge `json:"transitions"`
	}{graph.Goal, graph.Targets, graph.Transitions})
	if err != nil {
		return OnboardingPathAuthoringInput{}, err
	}
	digest := sha256.Sum256(topology)
	result := OnboardingPathAuthoringInput{Schema: OnboardingPathAuthoringInputSchema, Goal: graph.Goal, TopologyHash: hex.EncodeToString(digest[:]), PlannerVersion: policy.PlannerVersion, PedagogyProfile: policy.PedagogyProfile, PresentationStyle: policy.PresentationStyle, GenerationPolicy: policy.GenerationPolicy, ContentLanguage: snapshot.Profile.ContentLanguage.Code, DirectionCode: snapshot.Profile.DirectionCode, SelfAssessedExperience: snapshot.Profile.SelfAssessedExperience}
	if snapshot.Profile.KnownStacks.State == StudentReadinessArrayAnswered {
		result.KnownStacks = append([]string(nil), snapshot.Profile.KnownStacks.Values...)
	}
	if snapshot.Profile.DesiredStacks.State == StudentReadinessArrayAnswered {
		result.DesiredStacks = append([]string(nil), snapshot.Profile.DesiredStacks.Values...)
	}
	return result, nil
}

func (input OnboardingPathAuthoringInput) Hash() (string, error) {
	if input.Schema != OnboardingPathAuthoringInputSchema || input.ContentLanguage == "" || input.TopologyHash == "" {
		return "", ErrValidation
	}
	b, err := json.Marshal(input)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	d := sha256.Sum256(b)
	return hex.EncodeToString(d[:]), nil
}
func (input OnboardingPathAuthoringInput) CourseContext() map[string]any {
	result := map[string]any{"schema": input.Schema, "goal": input.Goal, "topology_hash": input.TopologyHash, "planner_version": input.PlannerVersion, "pedagogy_profile": input.PedagogyProfile, "presentation_style": input.PresentationStyle, "generation_policy": input.GenerationPolicy, "content_language": input.ContentLanguage}
	if value := strings.TrimSpace(input.DirectionCode); value != "" {
		result["direction_code"] = value
	}
	if value := strings.TrimSpace(input.SelfAssessedExperience); value != "" {
		result["self_assessed_experience"] = value
	}
	if input.KnownStacks != nil {
		result["known_stacks"] = append([]string(nil), input.KnownStacks...)
	}
	if input.DesiredStacks != nil {
		result["desired_stacks"] = append([]string(nil), input.DesiredStacks...)
	}
	return result
}
